aardart.name: Aardart
aardart.description: It keeps count of every ant it has eaten, and celebrates significant numbers.

aardorn.name: Aardorn
aardorn.description: When born it is placed in an anthill and left to eat its way out.

abesnaki.name: Abesnaki
abesnaki.description: Each face is a different pattern, and some say the symbols spell out words in a dead language.

agnidon.name: Agnidon
agnidon.description: It prefers four legs, but can stand on two to open doors, push over trees or hold things.

agnigon.name: Agnigon
agnigon.description: It is called a 'false dragon', because it appears to be a dragon, but actually evolved from a different line of ancient reptiles.

agnite.name: Agnite
agnite.description: It is playful, but must be taught early on to keep its fire in check.

allagon.name: Allagon
allagon.description: ALLAGON are drawn to relics made from the metals left behind by their ancestors, and will be violent to retrieve them.

ampystoma.name: Ampystoma
ampystoma.description: You would think AMPYSTOMA's warning coloration would make ambush impossible, but the murky waters it hunts in obscure it until it is ready to reveal itself. It likes to go on land during thunderstorms.

angesnow.name: Angesnow
angesnow.description: Those who survive getting lost in hostile, icy conditions often mention a mysterious presence guiding them even when the snow is too heavy to see through.

angrito.name: Angrito
angrito.description: It cannot understand why humans feel rage and hatred, but ANGRITO feels these urges too.

anoleaf.name: Anoleaf
anoleaf.description: It considers the plants growing near it to be its brothers and sisters.

anu.name: Anu
anu.description: It is said that it enters others' dreams to search for its lost love.

apeoro.name: Apeoro
apeoro.description: The kings of old used psychic powers to transfer their souls into these golden computing machines. Now they live on, unable to communicate but still dreaming of empires.

araignee.name: Araignee
araignee.description: Pedants who say all spiders have eight legs are strangely quiet on the case of ARAIGNEE.

arthrobolt.name: Arthrobolt
arthrobolt.description: It feels uncomfortable commanding its fellow NUT and BOLT, and usually runs away. But then the NUT and BOLT have no one to instruct them.

av8r.name: AV8R
av8r.description: If the sun is out, it can fly as far or as high as it likes.

axolightl.name: Axolightl
axolightl.description: It lights the deep waters with its tail, marking a safe shelter for fish.

b_ver_1.name: B-Ver.1
b_ver_1.description: It is designed for all those times you need something to be bitten by a robot.

bamboon.name: Bamboon
bamboon.description: It fights with its bamboo staff, which it also uses for balance.

baobaraffe.name: Baobaraffe
baobaraffe.description: It stores mass amounts of water in its huge body so that it can travel long distances across hot, dry deserts. It will also share water with thirsty creatures. When it has no water stored it is skinny.

baoby.name: Baoby
baoby.description: They travel from river to river in search of water to drink and store. The leafy ossicones on its head conceal movable points that act similar to a dowsing rod. Many creatures follow BAOBY in droughts.

bigfin.name: Bigfin
bigfin.description: A whole ecosystem exists on its back, so it tries not to go underwater.

birdling.name: Birdling
birdling.description: The ignorant believe that it carries its own egg upon its back. It is the guard for a far more important egg than that.

bishosand.name: Bishosand
bishosand.description: BISHOSAND is fascinated by religious or spiritual symbols it sees and likes to collect them, but is believed to not understand any of them.

blasdoor.name: Blasdoor
blasdoor.description: BLASDOOR shield those they care about behind their impenetrable bulk, but macerate unwanted intruders and scrap machines between their steel teeth.

bolt.name: Bolt
bolt.description: The presence of a BOLT makes a NUT clamp down harder and spark more energy.

boltnu.name: Boltnu
boltnu.description: It spends most of its time digging burrows into the ground, it remains dizzy from the constant vibrations and movement caused by them digging into the soil.

botbot.name: Botbot
botbot.description: It is a universal robot that can be adapted for any purpose.

boxali.name: Boxali
boxali.description: With its long blue cape, BOXALI can glide above the ground - allowing it to perform stunts and aerial attacks.

breem.name: Breem
breem.description: It punctures fruit to place new DUGGOT in them by night. By day it pretends to be a normal bee.

brewdin.name: Brewdin
brewdin.description: Born in neglected, once prized, pottery and similar treasures. Rumored to grants wishes to those who can make it smile.

bricgard.name: Bricgard
bricgard.description: When the winter comes, IMBRICKCILE builds a defensive cocoon of bricks to protect it from predators.

brickhemoth.name: Brickhemoth
brickhemoth.description: Be wary when kicking a BRICGARD's nest, because percussive force is the trigger the tuxemon needs to burst forth once it has formed into a BRICKHEMOTH.

budaye.name: Budaye
budaye.description: It can convince any group to cooperate for the common good with some encouraging mewls and waves.

bugnin.name: Bugnin
bugnin.description: Its sword is actually an antenna grown and snapped off for that purpose.

bursa.name: Bursa
bursa.description: It rejects fire as basic, and produces only the fire of the mind.

cairfrey.name: Cairfrey
cairfrey.description: A jolly piece of furniture who awoke one morning and decided to explore.

caper.name: Caper
caper.description: CAPER play and frolic with each other among the foam of mountain rivers, cold as ice.

capinyah.name: Capinyah
capinyah.description: Only after intense training in the jungles, lifting logs and river boulders, can CAPITI graduate to become CAPINYAH.

capiti.name: Capiti
capiti.description: It looks like a baby, but some specimens have been found that are hundreds of years old.

cardiling.name: Cardiling
cardiling.description: One wouldn't expect it to breathe fire, until it does.

cardinale.name: Cardinale
cardinale.description: It hates all predators with a passion, and makes war with them and their young when it can.

cardiwing.name: Cardiwing
cardiwing.description: Its song is remarkable, but few dare keep an explosive songbird.

cataspike.name: Cataspike
cataspike.description: It learns to fight from observation. Left to its own devices, it uses its spike to pick up rubbish.

cateye.name: Cateye
cateye.description: They say it blinks once a year, in honor of summer's end.

chromeye.name: Chromeye
chromeye.description: CHROMEYE was created to observe and learn how humans think and feel.

coaldiak.name: Coaldiak
coaldiak.description: This bear can set fire to anywhere and draw blood from anything.

cochini.name: Cochini
cochini.description: It is as intelligent and aware as a three-year old child. It tastes delicious.

cocrune.name: Cocrune
cocrune.description: Whichever way it turns, the blood-red eye faces you.

coleorus.name: Coleorus
coleorus.description: It has existed, unchanged, for millions of years.

conifrost.name: Conifrost
conifrost.description: If it sneezes, an avalanche occurs. It has a permanent sniffle.

conileaf.name: Conileaf
conileaf.description: Foods placed in its pitcher are blended and pickled. They are used to store food without it going off.

coppi.name: Coppi
coppi.description: COPPI's flowers are surprisingly bitter and smelly, but they are useful in beer brewing and medicine.

coproblight.name: Coproblight
coproblight.description: Born from the feces of prehistoric Tuxemon, it used the shards of bone within itself for defense.

corvix.name: Corvix
corvix.description: It arms its wings with bone shards from its victims.

cowpignon.name: Cowpignon
cowpignon.description: Some people dry it out and eat it as a medicinal enhancement.

crankus.name: Crankus
crankus.description: From one mountaintop to another, CRANKUS can be heard bleating to one another in running arguments that end only with the spring thaws.

criniotherme.name: Criniotherme
criniotherme.description: Its mane shines during the day, grows big and red at sunset, and blows away as ash at night.

dandicub.name: Dandicub
dandicub.description: After a litter is born, they float all over the world and never see their family again.

dandylion.name: Dandylion
dandylion.description: It gives birth to one litter in its life. Then it wanders the world trying to find them.

delfeco.name: Delfeco
delfeco.description: DELFECO's streamlined body allows for swift navigation through water, and its intelligence is evident in its complex hunting strategies. Despite its size, it's known for its playful nature and strong bond with its trainer.

dinoflop.name: Dinoflop
dinoflop.description: DINOFLOP delights in quickly turning away from its attackers so their blows land on its shielded and spiny back.

djinnbo.name: Djinnbo
djinnbo.description: It is mistakenly believed that it is a human who died in a fire. Actually, its relatives did.

dollfin.name: Dollfin
dollfin.description: Each one follows a ship from place to place, exploring the world.

dracune.name: Dracune
dracune.description: It is immobile during the day, but can wriggle and bite at night.

dragarbor.name: Dragarbor
dragarbor.description: When it feels it is coming to the end of its life, it travels to a graveyard where it plants itself. Its tail flower grows forever.

drashimi.name: Drashimi
drashimi.description: It lies on the ground, smelling delicious and tempting monsters to take a bite - but when they approach, it bites them first.

drokoro.name: Drokoro
drokoro.description: Once it had a family, but it ate its parents, and it ate its children, and it ate its mate, and it ate all of its kind.

duggot.name: Duggot
duggot.description: When TUMBLEBEE tries to drink fruit juice, a DUGGOT may latch on and take over its brain.

dune_pincher.name: Dune Pincher
dune_pincher.description: These hermits will wrap themselves in whatever is closest. In the desert, that is the burial shrouds of long-dead pharaohs.

dynastor.name: Dynastor
dynastor.description: DYNASTOR is a massive insectoid tuxemon with a deep, armored exoskeleton and distinctive wings running along its back. Its mandibles can crush steel.

eaglace.name: Eaglace
eaglace.description: When it takes flight, clouds form. When it claps its wings, hail falls.

elofly.name: Elofly
elofly.description: An ELOFLY on its own is patient and wise, but when it flocks in great numbers it becomes violent and impulsive.

elostorm.name: Elostorm
elostorm.description: Kings and queens, the ELOSTORM rule their people and have great ambition.

elowind.name: Elowind
elowind.description: The lieutenants of the ELOFLY family, ELOWIND shepherd the flock and keep it focused.

embazook.name: Embazook
embazook.description: It is trained for use in war and it knows no other life.

embra.name: Embra
embra.description: It eats everything it can to grow big enough to become a RUPTION.

enduros.name: Enduros
enduros.description: ENDUROS is an aggressive brawler that does not pull its blows. Out of the ring, it is quite sociable.

eruptibus.name: Eruptibus
eruptibus.description: Smiths work with it, heating up metals in its caldera.

exapode.name: Exapode
exapode.description: It waves its legs to attract attention, but mostly people just run away.

exclawvate.name: Exclawvate
exclawvate.description: Often seen on construction sites, they can use their huge hands and tail to scoop up dirt and rubble. Underneath the Tuxemon are caterpillar tires, giving them a better balance and grip while climbing heaps of rubble.

eyenemy.name: Eyenemy
eyenemy.description: It feeds on beautiful views and other spectacular sights.

eyesore.name: Eyesore
eyesore.description: It remembers everything it has ever seen, but not the order that it has seen it in.

fancair.name: Fancair
fancair.description: If someone leaves their fan running when they do not need it, it comes alive and flies out the window to find someone who actually needs to be cooled.

ferricran.name: Ferricran
ferricran.description: Once, the FERRICRAN were covered all over with adamantine scales, and had wings of mithril.

firomenis.name: Firomenis
firomenis.description: These tuxemon are large and tough from the many years spent as a MERLICUN. Their jaws can crush through trees and bones, and their flight is strong enough to carry people.

flacono.name: Flacono
flacono.description: It is totally unafraid of adversaries, and will attack an enemy of any size without hesitation.

flambear.name: Flambear
flambear.description: It can be tracked from the trail of boiled berry bushes and roasted trout it leaves in its wake.

flisces.name: Flisces
flisces.description: It skims the surface of the water, evading detection until a powerful leap brings its sharp fins into play.

flounce.name: Flounce
flounce.description: FLOUNCE can be stubborn and solitary, flouncing all the rules unless given good motivation.

flummack.name: Flummack
flummack.description: FLUMMACK no longer desires to be eaten, but to eat - even other FLUMMBY and FLUMMACK go down a treat.

flummby.name: Flummby
flummby.description: FLUMMBY was invented by a scientist who thought food that wanted to be eaten would be more ethical. It leaps into the mouth of anyone who could eat it.

fluoresfin.name: Fluoresfin
fluoresfin.description: When threatened, it huddles together with other FLUORESFIN to create a large blinding light to disorientate predators.

fluttaflap.name: Fluttaflap
fluttaflap.description: It feeds on impurities, so it returns purified blood to those it sucks on.

foofle.name: Foofle
foofle.description: When one is in danger, all FOOFLE hear its cries, wherever they are.

forturtle.name: Forturtle
forturtle.description: It heats its shell to read the future from the cracks that emerge.

foxfire.name: Foxfire
foxfire.description: FOXFIRE cubs are found in fires that burned out overnight. No one knows where they come from.

frondly.name: Frondly
frondly.description: It can do anything with its prehensile tail, even shake hands and pick fruit.

furnursus.name: Furnursus
furnursus.description: FURNURSUS are friendly, and often forget that their bodies are too hot for others to touch.

fuzzina.name: Fuzzina
fuzzina.description: When the child that abandoned a FUZZLET needs it again, it becomes a FUZZINA, a brave protector and nurturer of the small and the weak.

fuzzlet.name: Fuzzlet
fuzzlet.description: When a child is no longer around to play with their toys, they sometimes come to life.

galnec.name: Galnec
galnec.description: GALNEC buries itself deep in the hot sands of the desert, only its stony tail above ground. In packs, they look like gardens of stone.

gectile.name: Gectile
gectile.description: It is so quick and light that it can walk on leaves.

ghosteeth.name: Ghosteeth
ghosteeth.description: It smiles because it knows how everyone it meets is going to die.

graffiki.name: Graffiki
graffiki.description: GRAFFIKI are as at home in cities as they are in the jungle, tagging their territory with elaborate paintings.

grimachin.name: Grimachin
grimachin.description: It was made by a toy company to be a pet, but was too dangerous.

grinflare.name: Grinflare
grinflare.description: It is said that each is the walking heart of a volcano.

grintot.name: Grintot
grintot.description: It is a GRINTROCK or GRINFLARE that has experienced erosion.

grintrock.name: Grintrock
grintrock.description: It feeds by sitting out in thunderstorms, waiting to be struck by lightning.

gryfix.name: Gryfix
gryfix.description: Bone armor protects GRYFIX from all but the most powerful of attacks.

hampotamos.name: Hampotamos
hampotamos.description: It nibbles on RINOCEREED, clearing away dead skin, moss and weeds.

happito.name: Happito
happito.description: Why can't people always be happy? HAPPITO will give them exactly what they want, even if it is not what they need.

hatchling.name: Hatchling
hatchling.description: When an egg does not want to hatch and begin its next life stage, it becomes a HATCHLING.

hectapod.name: Hectapod
hectapod.description: When it inflates its dome, it floats to the top of oceans, or even through mist and clouds.

heronquak.name: Heronquak
heronquak.description: The crystal on its chest is mistaken for a diamond by poachers. It melts when it is removed from HERONQUAK's body.

hydrone.name: Hydrone
hydrone.description: It utilizes an experimental technology that creates power from water.

ignibus.name: Ignibus
ignibus.description: When threatened it retreats into its shell and cools down dramatically by venting steam. It could be mistaken for a rock.

imbrickcile.name: Imbrickcile
imbrickcile.description: IMBRICKCILE shelter inside a single brick, emerging only to lift it to build their strength.

incandesfin.name: Incandesfin
incandesfin.description: Its entire body has massively grown in size. However, its light is still the exact same.

jemuar.name: Jemuar
jemuar.description: The gems on its back are the type found when it was born. There are extensive ROCKITTEN breeding facilities over diamond veins.

k9.name: K9
k9.description: It is a helpful companion that can pull a tonne of weight.

katacoon.name: Katacoon
katacoon.description: It stays in a meditative pose for its chrysalis, moving only to jab enemies.

katapill.name: Katapill
katapill.description: It is born fighting. It has to punch out of its eggshell or be trapped.

kernel.name: Kernel
kernel.description: KERNEL is a core component of the monster system (kennel) and item system (locker), and serves as the main interface between the computer's physical hardware and the processes running on it. Known as JAS-KERI-BIT from its creators.

knightsand.name: Knightsand
knightsand.description: KNIGHTSAND patrols around sand castles inhabits by PAWSAND, but is terrible at building them.

knindling.name: Knindling
knindling.description: Any spark from a stone KNINDLING happily tenders into a fire.

komodraw.name: Komodraw
komodraw.description: It uses its claws to carve its firearm out of wood, and uses it for powerful ranged attacks.

komoduel.name: Komoduel
komoduel.description: Many a wrongdoer has fled town after seeing just the silhouette of an approaching KOMODUEL.

lambert.name: Lambert
lambert.description: It is placed in its nut by its parent, who then sends it into the world.

lapinou.name: Lapinou
lapinou.description: When SQUABBITS were taken as fashionable pets, they adapted to domestic life and lost their violent natures.

legko.name: Legko
legko.description: Long thought to be legless, its leaves are actually vestigial limbs.

lightmare.name: Lightmare
lightmare.description: It lurks in the depths of the ocean, luring any unsuspecting prey using its light right into its large, gaping mouth.

loliferno.name: Loliferno
loliferno.description: It is said that the LOLIFERNO's fire could not be extinguished. Yet, despite its power, LOLIFERNO has a playful side, and is known to dance among the flames it creates.

manosting.name: Manosting
manosting.description: It floats across the tops of cities, contemplating sharks.

masknake.name: Masknake
masknake.description: When frightened or aggressive, it flashes a beautiful pattern with its tail.

mauai.name: Mauai
mauai.description: MAUAI gives itself over to the spirits of lost warriors trapped inside its weapon.

medushock.name: Medushock
medushock.description: Tend to stay away from shore and known to be aggressive to people. Stingers are used to stun its prey. Swim safely.

memnomnom.name: Memnomnom
memnomnom.description: It is said that each one's mask is the face of a different dead king.

metesaur.name: Metesaur
metesaur.description: This Tuxemon would enjoy diving into the ground and leaving marks. Sometimes, the Tuxemon would misjudge the hit and land in trees, starting huge and dangerous forest fires.

miaownolith.name: Miaownolith
miaownolith.description: It can speak the human tongue, but only to say cryptic riddles.

mingdyn.name: Mingdyn
mingdyn.description: Every 12 years, a single MINGDYN egg is laid. Its discovery marks a time of renewal and upheaval across the land.

mk01_alpha.name: MK01 Alpha
mk01_alpha.description: A killer robot fused with a dragon. Don't ask us how.

mk01_beta.name: Mk01 Beta
mk01_beta.description: A killer robot fused with a dragon. Don't ask us how.

mk01_delta.name: Mk01 Delta
mk01_delta.description: A killer robot fused with a dragon. Don't ask us how.

mk01_gamma.name: Mk01 Gamma
mk01_gamma.description: A killer robot fused with a dragon. Don't ask us how.

mk01_omega.name: Mk01 Omega
mk01_omega.description: A killer robot fused with a dragon. Don't ask us how.

mk01_proto.name: Mk01 Proto
mk01_proto.description: A killer robot fused with a dragon. Don't ask us how.

moloch.name: Moloch
moloch.description: It can stiffen or soften its skin to respond to friends and foes.

mrmoswitch.name: mRmOswitch
mrmoswitch.description: These cheeky robots are used for their fine motor skills, but they love pranks.

mystikapi.name: Mystikapi
mystikapi.description: The MYSTIKAPI's saliva augments psychic powers. It licks its eyes and ears to heighten its senses.

narcileaf.name: Narcileaf
narcileaf.description: When a SHYBULB has restored a garden to glory, it morphs and proudly takes credit for its work.

neutrito.name: Neutrito
neutrito.description: NEUTRITO feels nothing. The perfect machine?

ninjasmine.name: Ninjasmine
ninjasmine.description: NINJASMINE poisons his opponents quickly using his two poison swords.

noctalo.name: Noctalo
noctalo.description: It inhabits only places abandoned by humans - castles, graveyards and sewers.

noctula.name: Noctula
noctula.description: It eats fruit and PIPIS eat bugs, so despite living in close proximity they do not compete.

nostray.name: Nostray
nostray.description: It can smell anything in the ocean, no matter how far away.

nudiflot_female.name: Nudiflot
nudiflot_female.description: It eats and stores the poison of the sea creatures that it feeds upon.

nudiflot_male.name: Nudiflot
nudiflot_male.description: Its feathery antennas snap off if it is attacked, confusing the predator.

nudikill.name: Nudikill
nudikill.description: They are called Dark Bishops because their heads are reminiscent of a bishop's hat.

nudimind.name: Nudimind
nudimind.description: It dreams of oceans under other skies.

nut.name: Nut
nut.description: In the great ships that cross the oceans, thousands of NUT and BOLT provide power and hold the steel plating together.

octabode.name: Octabode
octabode.description: OCTABODE make ancient vessels and artifacts their homes, dreaming of the lives of those who used the relics before them.

ouroboutlet.name: Ouroboutlet
ouroboutlet.description: The circuit focuses energy, creating a new type of electricity called griefed-lightning.

pairagrim.name: Pairagrim
pairagrim.description: One of PAIRAGRIM's heads is always searching for prey, while the other focuses on flying at great speed.

pairagrin.name: Pairagrin
pairagrin.description: The young form of Pairagrim, it is a generally happy creature. It struggles to fly until the two heads learn to work together.

pantherafira.name: Pantherafira
pantherafira.description: Each member of the pride lights their mane from a shared bonfire. As long as that fire burns, their strength is shared.

parappi.name: Parappi
parappi.description: When cut PARAPPI oozes syrup that seals and hardens over its enemies, turning them to amber.

pawsand.name: Pawsand
pawsand.description: PAWSAND inhabits sand castles and sand temples made by BISHOSAND and ROOKSAND, some of which are actually ROOKSAND itself.

pharavion.name: Pharavion
pharavion.description: After great effort, a trainer may evolve a clumsy PHARFAN calf into its adult form, which gracefully floats despite its huge size.

pharfan.name: Pharfan
pharfan.description: At the watering hole it keeps its friends RINOCEREED and HAMPOTAMOS well watered.

picc.name: PiCC
picc.description: It accompanies divers, providing much needed oxygen.

pigabyte.name: Pigabyte
pigabyte.description: Scientists found that the best computers have organic implants.

pipis.name: Pipis
pipis.description: Its cries are considered a bad omen, but it is a gentle creature.

polyrock.name: Polyrock
polyrock.description: It disguises itself as a human child to sneak into dojos and learn from martial arts masters.

possessun.name: Possessun
possessun.description: It is a ghost that inhabits a dead CAIRFREY.

potturmeist.name: Potturmeist
potturmeist.description: POTTURMEIST are spirits of the dead that take refuge in empty vessels. In ancient temples, acolytes must distract the monsters lest they interrupt important ceremonies.

potturney.name: Potturney
potturney.description: By the time a POTTURMEIST has reached its maturity, its protective urn has so changed shape that it resembles no pottery made by human hands. Some insist that the designs on a POTTURMEIST's urn are writings from the far future.

propellercat.name: Propellercat
propellercat.description: Is it a new species, or just the pet of an inventor?

prophetoise.name: Prophetoise
prophetoise.description: Its heavenly fire is something foes rarely see coming.

puparmor.name: Puparmor
puparmor.description: Its cocoon is so hard, people are knocked out if a PUPARMOR is dropped on them. They were once loaded into cannons and catapults.

pyraminx.name: Pyraminx
pyraminx.description: It has a tomb hidden somewhere in the land. If it finds it, it can sleep.

pythwire.name: Pythwire
pythwire.description: Observations of wild PYTHWIRE inspired the inventor of the first electrical outlet.

qetzlrokilus.name: Qetzlrokilus
qetzlrokilus.description: This Tuxemon would dive into groups of other dinosaur Tuxemon and burn them. They also enjoy setting forests alight and dropping their ashes into water to spoil its purity.

rabbitosaur.name: Rabbitosaur
rabbitosaur.description: Its tunnels are extensive and wide, the site of tremendous wars between burrows.

rhincus.name: Rhincus
rhincus.description: It has some properties of a reptile and some of a bird.

rhinocarpe.name: Rhinocarpe
rhinocarpe.description: RHINOCARPE are territorial, charging headfirst at any who swim too near to their coral fortresses.

rockat.name: Rockat
rockat.description: Despite its considerable weight, its footfalls are silent.

rockitten.name: Rockitten
rockitten.description: It uses its tiny rock ears for snuggling.

rooksand.name: Rooksand
rooksand.description: ROOKSAND sometimes allows those it deems worthy to live inside its sandcastle, and crushes all others.

rosarin.name: Rosarin
rosarin.description: ROSARIN's love is incredible, he's only asking some affection.

runesquito.name: Runesquito
runesquito.description: The blood-red marking is RUNESQUITO. The rest is just a rocky shell it rides alongside.

ruption.name: Ruption
ruption.description: Once EMBRA's flame becomes hot enough, it engulfs its entire body, essentially replacing it in the process.

sadito.name: Sadito
sadito.description: When a person is feeling too sad, SADITO will carry that burden for them.

sampsack.name: Sampsack
sampsack.description: A scientist wanted to separate his personalities, but he split his body.

sampsage.name: Sampsage
sampsage.description: A scientist took a drug that made him clever by day and violent by night.

sapragon.name: Sapragon
sapragon.description: In olden times, each element had a mighty dragon - but those creatures have diminished and are rare in these days.

sapsnap.name: Sapsnap
sapsnap.description: Its terrific anger is off putting, but it passes quickly.

sclairus.name: Sclairus
sclairus.description: When a crop is left unharvested - be it from laziness or disaster - its scarecrow becomes a dark and living creature.

seirein.name: Seirein
seirein.description: It grows lonely in the swamps, so it burns brightly to draw travelers near - but it is painfully shy and flits away when they approach.

selket.name: Selket
selket.description: Lying in wait beneath the sand, they can feel their prey through the vibrations of their footsteps.

selmatek.name: Selmatek
selmatek.description: Kept by the ancient kings of the deserts, SELMATEK served as watchdogs, hunting companions and - now - defenders against grave robbers.

seraphice.name: Seraphice
seraphice.description: SERAPHICE can freeze in ice moments of great courage and joy, stored away in deep vaults beneath the mountains for the days when humanity will need them most.

shammer.name: Shammer
shammer.description: In ancient times it hunted RHINCUS beneath ashen skies.

sharpfin.name: Sharpfin
sharpfin.description: It is invisible in the water, being visible only when it leaps out of the water to drag animals on the shore back into the deep.

sheye.name: Sheye
sheye.description: SHEYE are weighed down by heavy thoughts. Edgy trainers like them for their sinister appearance and solemn demeanor.

shnark.name: Shnark
shnark.description: SHNARK wears its last meal's flesh as a disguise so it can get close to its trusting prey.

shrab.name: Shrab
shrab.description: When a SHEYE frees its mind from always contemplating serious thoughts, it becomes a SHRAB, free in body to wander the world.

shybulb.name: Shybulb
shybulb.description: When a garden is neglected, a SHYBULB moves in and quietly tends the droopy plants.

skwib.name: Skwib
skwib.description: The SKWIB contentedly floats through the ocean, examining potential shell-homes. It has to fear for its life before it will finally make a choice.

sludgehog.name: Sludgehog
sludgehog.description: It lives in rubbish, and eats it too. Its spikes seem sharp, but it can soften them at will.

snaki.name: Snaki
snaki.description: SNAKI is a snake that has learned to grow legs by examining the motion of lizards and crocodiles.

snokari.name: Snokari
snokari.description: The two heads of SNOKARI each hold great wisdom, but they never agree.

sockeserp.name: Sockeserp
sockeserp.description: An otherwise formidable enemy, SOCKESERP is easily dispatched if it gets tangled up.

spighter.name: Spighter
spighter.description: It's not fair that something so good at sneaking up on people, can't be snuck up on itself.

spirain.name: Spirain
spirain.description: If a SEIREIN's inner fire dims, its water spirit nature turns it into SPIRAIN.

spycozeus.name: Spycozeus
spycozeus.description: The whispered communications of the forest are given physical form in SPYCOZEUS, which thinks like the trees.

squabbit.name: Squabbit
squabbit.description: To prove themselves, they will fight tooth and nail over even the smallest thing.

squink.name: Squink
squink.description: It is named for the noise it makes when it is all out of ink.

statursus.name: Statursus
statursus.description: STATURSUS has learned to channel its emotions into a single pure flame. The mere sight of it sends others into a trance.

strella.name: Strella
strella.description: Its tails are lures to convince bugs to bite them and be trapped.

sumchon.name: Sumchon
sumchon.description: It uses its weight to trip much larger enemies. It is as dense as a star.

tarpeur.name: Tarpeur
tarpeur.description: They rest and grow. They also grow and rest. Rarely, they rest without growing or grow without resting.

taupypus.name: Taupypus
taupypus.description: Upon their birth, a TAUPYPUS' eyes are burst by its mother. That way, their eyes will never sting when they dive into the water.

tetrchimp.name: Tetrchimp
tetrchimp.description: They absorb any information they come across. Their constant chatter communicates everything they have learned in order.

tigrock.name: Tigrock
tigrock.description: It is said that it had to invent itself because an evolution was not designed.

tikoal.name: Tikoal
tikoal.description: The guardian of a forest-dwelling people, it keeps guard and resolves disputes.

tikorch.name: Tikorch
tikorch.description: It is the intermediary between forest and volcano, between sun and earth.

tobishimi.name: Tobishimi
tobishimi.description: TOBISHIMI spawn eggs in vast numbers, and carry them about under their chins for safekeeping until the next full moon - when they hatch.

tornicane.name: Tornicane
tornicane.description: TORNICANE harnesses the power of both tornado and hurricane. It is a living force of nature and may be savior or doom to those hoping for rain.

toufigel.name: Toufigel
toufigel.description: It appears to be a fluffy insect, but it is actually a reptile coated in soft snow.

tourbidi.name: Tourbidi
tourbidi.description: If you find a circle of mushrooms or clover, it is a place where TOURBIDI dance.

toxiris.name: Toxiris
toxiris.description: TOXIRIS is extremely powerful, it violently poisons everything in its way.

trapsnap.name: Trapsnap
trapsnap.description: Its head is the only part of its body that doesn't grow as it ages.

tsushimi.name: Tsushimi
tsushimi.description: While sometimes referred to as its armor, the fleshy plates on TSUSHIMI are softer than its skin. Their purpose remains unknown.

tumblebee.name: Tumblebee
tumblebee.description: It builds hives that are perfect spheres, with the TUMBLEBEE inside just rolling about and buzzing with laughter.

tumbledillo.name: Tumbledillo
tumbledillo.description: Tumbledillo have a mystical connection to a particular road, and they guard it from people who would interfere with it - even pothole repair crews!

tumblequill.name: Tumblequill
tumblequill.description: Tumblequill rolls along the highways, gathering up useful items for its nests from the rubbish left by the side of the road.

tumbleworm.name: Tumbleworm
tumbleworm.description: When they have outgrown their honeycomb eggs, they drop to the ground face first.

tweesher.name: Tweesher
tweesher.description: The colder the weather, the harder its beak. At below 0 degrees, it is harder than diamond.

urcheedle.name: Urcheedle
urcheedle.description: It can't move or attack, so it sits still and prays that the opponent damages itself on its many needles.

urcine.name: Urcine
urcine.description: When a FURNURSUS is born without the fire inside, it is abandoned in the forests as an URCINE.

vamporm.name: Vamporm
vamporm.description: It thirsts for blood, but must make do with tree sap.

velocitile.name: Velocitile
velocitile.description: It can outrun a bullet, but only when it has warmed up.

vigueur.name: Vigueur
vigueur.description: VIGUEUR compete to see who can lift the heaviest rocks. When they lift one that is too heavy, it squashes them and scatters TARPEUR seeds.

vivicinder.name: Vivicinder
vivicinder.description: It makes its nest in long-burning fires, either of its own creation or in memorials, smithies and glassworks.

vividactil.name: Vividactil
vividactil.description: In ancient times, the Year of the VIVIDACTIL marked a time of renewal and the restoration of authority.

vivipere.name: Vivipere
vivipere.description: It hatches in great numbers in the summer, but the rest of its lifespan is a mystery.

viviphyta.name: Viviphyta
viviphyta.description: It is the king of snakes - or at least believes itself to be such.

vivisource.name: Vivisource
vivisource.description: The spring it chooses for its home always has a peculiar oniony taste.

viviteel.name: Viviteel
viviteel.description: It takes the armor of a fallen warrior and repurposes it for a shell.

vivitrans.name: Vivitrans
vivitrans.description: The cold focuses VIVITRANS' mind to a keen edge.

vivitron.name: Vivitron
vivitron.description: Early philosophers used VIVITRON as evidence that natural forces can be tamed and controlled.

volcoli.name: Volcoli
volcoli.description: It is the spirit of a forest. Its hair changes with the seasons.

volconey.name: Volconey
volconey.description: When VOLCONEY thump the earth with their gigantic feet, they call more and more THUMPURN and VOLCONEY to the warren. But when enough strike the earth at once, it is said to cause volcanic eruptions.

vulpyre.name: Vulpyre
vulpyre.description: How it evolves and lives is very mysterious, but it is sometimes spotted near a volcano.

weavifly.name: Weavifly
weavifly.description: When it is heavy with egg, it becomes unable to fly.

windeye.name: Windeye
windeye.description: Like a mighty tree, WINDEYE plants itself on the top of hills to soak in the sun and wind. Recharged, it then leaves to find another place under the sky.

wolffsky.name: Wolffsky
wolffsky.description: This tuxemon is very friendly. It is common to go hunting with the help of WOLFFSKY.

woodoor.name: Woodoor
woodoor.description: When a haunted house burns to the ground, sometimes all that is left is the front door. It hops away to find its next home.

ziggurat.name: Ziggurat
ziggurat.description: No labyrinth can contain ZIGGURAT. It decorates its nests with carvings of all the mazes it has traversed over the years.

zunna.name: Zunna
zunna.description: Cheerful ZUNNA sucks up all the food it can find into its stomach.
